newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wo Kee Hong in HK$111 mln rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Wo Kee Hong in HK$111 mln rights plan.

text.p: Audiovisual equipment distributor Wo Kee Hong (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it proposed to raise HK$111.3 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of 222.59 million new shares.

The company said it proposed to issue one rights share for every five existing shares held at HK$0.50 each, representing a 43.18 percent discount to its consolidated net tangible asset value per share of HK$0.88 each as at the end of December 1996.
Wo Kee Hong shares ended at HK$0.62 on Thursday.
The 222.59 million new shares will represent 16.67 percent of the company's enlarged share capital. There were a total 1.11 billion shares in issue as on April 17, 1996, it said.

Of the proceeds, about HK$33 million will be used to expand its distribution network in China and to promote the company's products, HK$33 million for developing home electrical appliances, HK$33 million to reduce outstanding debts, and HK$12 million for acquiring new distributorships, the statement said.
The register of members will be closed from May 23 to 30.
Wo Kee Hong posted a loss of HK$236.63 million for the year ended in December 1996, compared with a HK$18.08 million loss in the year earlier period.
